Summary:
- Mid-market SaaS: customer-facing knowledge product used by B2B ops teams. Heavy search + personalization layer.
- Primary objective: implement a reranking endpoint to improve relevance precision at top-5 results, then phase to live Dedicated pool once throughput/cost understood.

Recent timeline (bullets):
- 2026-01-22: Intro call (AE Maya) - initial intake, confirmed need for reranking + offline evaluation.
- 2026-02-02: Demo of Hosted API (basic generation + embeddings) - product team impressed with latency; asked about rerank-specific endpoint.
- 2026-02-18: Follow-up deep-dive w/ SE Jordan - discussed candidate generation vs rerank, sample eval set (attached).
- 2026-02-25: Security pre-check w/ security lead (emailed SSO/KMS questionnaire). Jira SEC-3365 logged for KMS questions.
- 2026-03-01: Pricing discussion; asked for committed capacity pricing for Dedicated + expected token/unit calculations at 200 qps peak.
- 2026-03-05: Agreed on POC scope: 2-week offline scoring POC using rerank endpoint + 5k eval set run; deliver eval script and sample rollout plan.

Use-case & requirements notes (shorthand):
- workload: nightly offline scoring of candidate lists (5k queries), plus online rerank at ~150-250 qps spikes for interactive search.
- perf targets: p99 latency < 90ms for rerank call (top-10 candidates), steady-state throughput 150 qps, burst to 300 qps allowed with fallbacks.
- cost sensitivity: mid - willing to commit if unit economics under $0.002/request at typical QPS; wants Dedicated pricing scenario.
- model prefs: prefer open model variants (quantized) but want Redwood to validate latency/quality tradeoffs. Interested in quantized rerank models + fallback to smaller LLM for cold-start.
- routing/fallback: require automatic fallback to hosted smaller model if Dedicated pool saturated, prefer policy-based routing by region + SLAs.
- security/compliance: SSO (SAML), audit logs for every rerank decision (must surface request ids), KMS integration for keys, data residency for EU subset of customers.

Notes from stakeholder quotes (paraphrase):
- "We need top-5 accuracy lift measurable in A/B within 2 weeks of POC" - Head of Product (R. Alvarez).
- "Cost per query is the gating factor - show us 3 scenarios (hosted, dedicated, hybrid)" - CFO (finance lead).
